nodes.title: Claude Code sessions have no secret-file guard on platform-k: add the PS-1361 hook with PS-1387's local-only exemption, covering every systemTest env and secrets file (and .env.stripe is not git-ignored)
nodes.description:
## BLUF

platform-s blocks a Claude Code session from printing a secret file ([PS-1361](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1361/block-claude-code-sessions-from-printing-secret-files-hook-rule)), and is about to let through files that hold only local values ([PS-1387](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1387/secret-file-guard-exempt-local-only-values-systemtestenv-local-slot), [Secuura/platform-s#1199](https://linear.app/secuura/review/ps-1387-secret-file-guard-lets-local-only-values-through-55c48feacc56), In Review). **platform-k has neither.** At `develop` `bd6697e07` the repo's tracked `.claude/` holds only `skills/secuura-test-discipline/SKILL.md`: no `settings.json` and no hook. Nothing stops a session from running `cat`, `grep` or `diff` on `Blockchain/Dev/.env` (PII keys, JWT keys, datastore passwords), `.env.local` (OAuth and IdP credentials) or any systemTest secrets file. The only protection is a rule the session has to remember. [PS-1361](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1361/block-claude-code-sessions-from-printing-secret-files-hook-rule) exists because that failed on platform-s on 26 Oct 2026 (`terraform fmt -check -diff .` printed every dev-ps secret).

Separately, `.env.stripe`-style files, which are planned, are **not git-ignored** on platform-k today (measured below).

## Verified (28 Oct 2026, K `develop` `bd6697e07`)

**K has no guard:** `git ls-files .claude` returns only the skill file.

**systemTest env and secrets files: tracked templates, and the real file each produces (all git-ignored, checked with** `git check-ignore` **on the file path):**

| Real file (git-ignored) | Template (tracked) | Holds |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `systemTest/playwright/.env` | `systemTest/playwright/.env.example` | Playwright credentials and targets |
| `systemTest/akto/.env` | `systemTest/akto/.env.example` | Akto harness env |
| `systemTest/akto/docker.env` | `systemTest/akto/docker.env.example` | Akto container env |
| `systemTest/akto/config/secrets.yml` | `systemTest/akto/config/secrets.example.yml` | Akto role credentials |
| `systemTest/performance/config/secrets.yml` | `systemTest/performance/config/secrets.example.yml` | k6 credentials |
| `systemTest/schemathesis/.env-slot<N>` | written by `scripts/run.py setup` | per-slot API token |
| `.env-*` slot credential files ([KS-674](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-674/playwright-documentsspects-3-cases-fail-whenever-their-slot-runs), root `.gitignore:14-16`) | written by tooling | slot-scoped credentials |

`systemTest/performance/config/environments.yml` is tracked. Whether it may name a secret value is not established.

**platform-k product code: env and credential files the services, frontends and deployments read.** Each was checked with `git check-ignore` on the real file path, 28 Oct 2026, `bd6697e07`.

| Real file | Template (tracked) | Ignored? | Holds |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `Blockchain/Dev/.env` | `Blockchain/Dev/env.example` (canonical, [KS-1081](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1081/config-drift-two-tracked-env-templates-disagree-by-39-vars-bootstrap)); also `Blockchain/Dev/.env.example` | yes | PII encryption and lookup keys, JWT keypair, datastore passwords, `ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD`, `GATEWAY_VOUCH_SECRET` |
| `Blockchain/Dev/.env.local` | `Blockchain/Dev/.env.local.example` (also `env.local.example`) | yes | OAuth / IdP client secrets |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/<svc>/.env` for analytics, anchoring, api-gateway, auth, billing, governance, guardian, kyc, m365-integration, nft-certificate, originate, prism, queue, referral, security, staking, timestamping, transfer, vc-issuer, wallet-connector (20 services) | `services/<svc>/.env.example` | yes, all 20 | per-service secrets (billing: Stripe keys; m365: Microsoft app secret; kyc: provider keys) |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/billing/` real file for its second template | `services/billing/env.example` | **not established**: the real file name for this no-dot template is unknown | Stripe keys |
| `Blockchain/Dev/deployment/azure/.env.staging` | `deployment/azure/env.staging.example` | yes | Azure staging deployment values |
| `Blockchain/Dev/deployment/cardano/.env` | `deployment/cardano/env.example` | yes | Cardano node / wallet configuration |
| `Blockchain/Dev/frontend/{admin,issuer,verifier}/.env.development` | none tracked | yes | frontend local overrides |
| `Blockchain/Dev/test-wallet.env`, `Blockchain/Dev/*.wallet.env` | none | yes (`.gitignore:133-135`) | wallet seed phrases |
| `Blockchain/Dev/docker/nginx-gateway/ssl/*.pem`, `*.key` | none | yes (`.gitignore:70-72`) | TLS private keys |
| `.keys/`, `credentials.json`, `*-credentials.json` | none | yes (`.gitignore:93`, `:138-139`) | key material, service-account credentials |
| `USER_TESTING/Testing Harness/handoff/` | none | yes (`.gitignore:185-186`) | super-admin login handoff |
| `observability/.env`, `observability/config/alerting.env` | `observability/.env.example`, `observability/config/alerting.env.example` | yes | alerting webhooks and tokens |
| `Blockchain/Dev/services/billing/.env.stripe` (planned style) | none | **NOT ignored** | would hold Stripe keys |

Every row except the last belongs in the hook's refuse list, and none qualifies for the local-only exemption: these are product secrets, not systemTest targets. The "Holds" column is from the template names and the service's purpose, not from opening any real file.

`.env.stripe` **is not git-ignored:**

```
K  systemTest/.env.stripe          NOT-ignored
K  Blockchain/Dev/.env.stripe      NOT-ignored
```

K's root `.gitignore` names `.env`, `.env-*`, `.env.local` and a fixed list of `.env.<stage>` names, not `.env.*`. A Stripe file created today could be committed.

## Proposed scope (for the owner to decide)

1. **A PreToolUse hook for Bash, Read and Grep**, `onFailure: block`, modelled on platform-s's `.claude/hooks/block_secret_reads.py`:
   * it refuses any reader (cat, grep, sed, diff, jq, base64, …) pointed at the files above, plus Terraform state, plans and tfvars, and an unformatted `docker inspect` or `docker exec … env` on K containers;
   * it allows a command that only names a file (`ls`, `stat`, `test -f`, `git check-ignore`);
   * it allows a single-field `docker inspect --format`, which the K build proof uses for `org.opencontainers.image.revision`.
2. [PS-1387](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1387/secret-file-guard-exempt-local-only-values-systemtestenv-local-slot)**'s local-only exemption, if Kamil agrees.** A systemTest env file whose every URL / base-URL key points at `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` is readable. Anything remote, missing or unreadable stays secret. `Blockchain/Dev/.env` **and** `.env.local` **stay guarded whatever their URLs**, because they hold real PII-encryption, JWT and OAuth material.
3. **A** `.gitignore` **rule for** `.env.*` **env files** (`.env.stripe` and successors) that keeps every `*.example` template tracked.
4. **A contract test pinning what the hook refuses and allows**, as platform-s's `SecretReadHookContractTests` does. Fixture files go in a temp folder, never the real ones.

**Why it matters for running the suites.** Building K, building S and running every systemTest suite need these files created and merged from their templates. With a guard on K, the exemption in item 2 decides which K files a session can merge blind. That needs settling before the guard lands, or the env-setup step breaks the same way.

## Runs on a developer's Mac, as platform-s#1199 does

platform-s#1199 ([PS-1387](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1387/secret-file-guard-exempt-local-only-values-systemtestenv-local-slot)) is written for a developer's own Mac running local stack slots. The platform-k guard should take the same shape:

* **Where it runs.** A Claude Code `PreToolUse` hook on the Mac, registered in `.claude/settings.json` as `python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/<name>.py"`, `onFailure: block`. `python3` ships with macOS (Xcode Command Line Tools), so no install is needed. `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is the session's project folder, normally the root checkout, not a ticket worktree. A guard change therefore takes effect once the root checkout is on a `develop` that contains it.
* **What "this machine" means.** As in #1199: `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`, `[::1]`. A systemTest env file is exempt only while every URL / base-URL key in it points there. That covers the local slots `SECUURA_STACK_SLOT` 1–4, gateway `6882 + 100·(N−1)`. A file pointed at Kintsugi, demo-pk, Container Apps or any remote host stays secret, and so does a missing or unreadable file.
* **Still guarded on the Mac, as in #1199:**
  * a bare `env` / `printenv`, because the developer's shell holds real tokens;
  * the product files in the table above, which are real keys even on a laptop;
  * Terraform state, plans and tfvars.
* **K slot containers (**`secuura-s<N>-*`**, and slot 1's** `secuura-*`**).** Unlike platform-s's slot containers, they are **not** exempt. Their environment comes from `Blockchain/Dev/.env` and `.env.local` (PII and JWT keys, OAuth secrets). An unformatted `docker inspect`, or `docker exec … env` / `printenv`, is refused. A single-field `docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.revision" }}'` and `--format '{{.RestartCount}}'` stay allowed, because the build proof needs them.
* **macOS tools.** The rules match on command text, so they must hold for BSD `sed`, `grep`, `stat` and `xargs` as well as GNU forms.
* **A search pattern that names a secret file is not a read** (the #1199 false-positive fix). For example, `grep -E 'tfvars|tfstate' .gitignore` is allowed. A secret file as a file operand, or as the value of `-f`, is still refused. This session's own grep of K's `.gitignore` was refused by platform-s's guard for exactly this reason.

## Acceptance criteria

1. **An automated test, offline on macOS.** A contract test, run by the K preflight and the pre-push hook with no stack up, drives the hook through `python3` on the Mac. It covers:
   * a refused and an allowed case for every file in the tables above;
   * a localhost, a remote-URL and a missing-file case for each exempt systemTest file;
   * the K-container `docker inspect` / `exec` rules;
   * a search-pattern-only grep (allowed);
   * a `.env.stripe` file that is git-ignored while its `.example` is not.

   Fixture files go in a temp folder, never the real ones.
2. **Docs:** `CLAUDE.md` → security section, and `systemTest/CLAUDE.md`, name the guard, the exemption and the file list. `Projects Documents/Stack-Slots-How-To.md` is changed only if the env-setup steps change.
3. **systemTests:** no spec, page object or fixture change. The guard's test is a contract test. Each systemTest `.env.example` should say in a comment whether its real file is exempt.

## Related

* [PS-1361](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1361/block-claude-code-sessions-from-printing-secret-files-hook-rule) (the platform-s guard).
* [PS-1387](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1387/secret-file-guard-exempt-local-only-values-systemtestenv-local-slot) / platform-s#1199 (the local-only exemption, In Review).
* [KS-1608](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1608/akto-harness-writes-credentials-to-disk-and-into-reports-reportjson) (Akto credentials written to reports, Done).
* [KS-1098](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1098/k6-runner-echo-mask-enamevalue-and-qe-namevalue-still-print-the-value) (k6 echo mask).
* [KS-674](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-674/playwright-documentsspects-3-cases-fail-whenever-their-slot-runs) (slot credential files).
* [KS-1081](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-1081/config-drift-two-tracked-env-templates-disagree-by-39-vars-bootstrap) (env template drift).

Raised from the [PS-1381](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-1381/systemtest-a11y-keyboard-journey-power-user-keyboard-enter-on-the) session. **Not assigned:** the `.claude/` tooling owner on platform-k is undecided. The systemTest parts are Peter's, the rest is Kamil's.
